principles: freshness is per source, not per page
authority exactness and observational freshness are separate dimensions
stale data can remain visible only as last-known
action ripeness requires fresh evidence for every action-relevant dependency

defaults.canonical_authority: NO_TTL; exact read required for every projection compile
defaults.return_plane_cursor: exact read required for every projection compile
defaults.github_pr_state: fresh per compile; if fetch fails do not reuse as current
defaults.deployment_status: fresh per compile when used for an action/readiness claim
defaults.runtime_liveness: fresh per compile when used for action/readiness claim

clock_rule: record source observed_at and local fetched_at; do not infer freshness from file mtime alone
